default.description: Capability for the main window. Detached floating windows (label = detached-*) intentionally use the separate, minimal `detached` capability instead — see capabilities/detached.json and docs/risks/r10-tauri-capabilities.md.

detached.description: Minimal capability for floating tab windows (label = detached-*). Only the surface needed by DetachedView (Terminal) and the WebLinksAddon URL handler. Excludes dialog, notification, and any sensitive plugin permissions to reduce blast radius if the renderer is compromised. See docs/risks/r10-tauri-capabilities.md for context.
